page_title: ATA 6-1 VER | Atalanta v Verona 26/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+1' That's all for today as the game is over.
87' Atalanta fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Dailon Rocha Livramento leaves the pitch and Faride Alidou (Verona) comes on.
79' Nicolo Zaniolo (Atalanta) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Lorenzo Montipo stops the ball from hitting the bottom left corner.
77' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to make a change. Marco Palestra (Atalanta) replaces Sead Kolasinac.
77' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Atalanta is cautioned for aggressive play.
70' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.
67' Substitution. Suat Serdar makes his way off the pitch and Tomas Suslov (Verona) comes on as his replacement.
62' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nicolo Zaniolo (Atalanta) replacing Mateo Retegui.
58' 6 - 1 Goal Mateo Retegui (Atalanta)! Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) was put through by Charles De Ketelaere and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the top left corner. 6:1.
56' Substitution. Davide Zappacosta will be replaced by Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta).
56' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ederson trots off the pitch and is replaced by Mario Pasalic (Atalanta).
56' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to substitute Ademola Lookman and he is replaced by Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta).
54' Atalanta can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
54' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) controls a pass, goes past a defender and curls a shot from the edge of the box right onto the crossbar.
54' The Atalanta players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
49' Daniele Ghilardi (Verona) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
46' Half-time substitution. Grigoris Kastanos is replaced by Dani Silva (Verona).
46' The game is over for Domagoj Bradaric. Flavius Daniliuc (Verona) comes on for the second half.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Paolo Zanetti gives a chance to Darko Lazovic (Verona) and Diego Coppola is off.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

42' 5 - 1 Amin Sarr (Verona) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes straight into the top left corner. He couldn't have done it any better. 5:1.
41' Ederson (Atalanta) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. Some classy goalkeeping by Lorenzo Montipo stops the ball out of the bottom right corner.

40' Atalanta are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
34' 5 - 0 Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
33' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) has a great chance to score from deep inside the box! He creates some space for the shot, but blazes it high over the crossbar. Very bad attempt.
31' The corner is swung in but Verona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

29' 4 - 0 Goal! Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom left corner. Lorenzo Montipo had no chance of reaching it. The score is 4:0.
25' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atalanta.

25' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the roof of the net is denied by a decent save from Lorenzo Montipo. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick.
21' 73:27 – the latest ball possession ratio.
16' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Ermano Feliciani didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
16' Verona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
15' 3 - 0 Goal! Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the top left corner.

14' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) meets a cross inside the penalty area and unloads a good attempt towards the bottom left corner. Lorenzo Montipo is prepared, though, and denies him with a fantastic save.
13' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar.
12' A corner kick by Atalanta is thwarted by the well prepared Lorenzo Montipo (Verona).
9' 2 - 0 Goal! Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot inside the left post. It's 2:0.
9' Atalanta keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
6' 1 - 0 Marten de Roon (Atalanta) receives a great pass from his teammate and strikes a very powerful shot towards goal that goes inside of the right post!
4' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Verona will have the kick-off.
Ermano Feliciani is introduced as the referee for today's match.
